analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Application funnel, job performance, and monthly trends.
analytics.funnelEmptyBody: Application data will appear here once candidates apply to your jobs.
analytics.trendEmpty: No data for the last 6 months.
analytics.insightLowShortlist: Shortlist rate is below 15% — consider broadening your screening criteria or refining job descriptions to attract better-fit candidates.
analytics.insightHighShortlist: High shortlist rate detected. Strong candidate quality for active roles.
analytics.insightConversionLow: Conversion rate: {rate}% of applicants were hired. Consider streamlining your interview pipeline to reduce drop-off.
analytics.insightConversionHigh: Conversion rate: {rate}% of applicants were hired. Strong pipeline conversion.
analytics.insightHighRejection: Over 60% of applicants were not selected. Refining job requirements or adding a pre-screening question can improve match quality.
analytics.insightTrendUp: Application volume is up significantly this month — high interest signal. Act quickly to shortlist top candidates.
analytics.insightTrendDown: Application volume dropped this month. Consider boosting job visibility or refreshing the job description.
analytics.insightTopJob: "{title}" is your best-performing role with {count} applications. Prioritize reviewing this queue.
analytics.insightNoData: No active applications yet. Post your first job to start receiving candidate insights.
